name: Auau
source:
Near future. Main character works hard at part-time jobs and finally can afford to buy an android maid. However, she is defective and has much wider range of emotions and senses than usual. She begs protagonist not to exchange her immediately. There are two weeks of free exchange period to test her properly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
近未来。主人公拼命打工，终于攒够了购买仿生人女仆的钱。然而他买到的却是一台次品，她拥有远比普通型号丰富的情感和感官。她苦苦哀求主人公不要立刻将自己退换。免费换货期限还有2周，足够他好好测试她的性能。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
